papers.title: Thermally Robust Piezoelectric KNN/Polyimide Separator for Regulating Lithium Deposition in Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐metal batteries offer exceptionally high theoretical energy density but are hindered by dendrite‐induced short circuits and the limited thermal stability of conventional separators. Here, we report a thermally robust piezoelectric composite separator composed of highly fluorinated polyimide and potassium sodium niobate (KNN), fabricated through an electrospinning/imidization strategy. Molecular dipole engineering, preferential through‐thickness polarization, and ceramic‐polymer electromechanical coupling collectively enable regulation of the local interfacial electric field, homogenized Li + flux, and suppressed lithium dendrite growth during cycling. Meanwhile, the rigid polyimide framework endows the separator with excellent thermal tolerance and structural integrity at elevated temperatures. Consequently, LiFePO 4 ||Li cells retain 88.5% of their initial capacity after 1900 cycles at 2 C. This work demonstrates an electromechanically active separator that integrates intrinsic thermal stability with interfacial regulation, providing a potential strategy for improving the durability of lithium‐metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 고불소화 폴리이미드와 KNN 압전세라믹을 전기방사/이미드화로 결합한 열적으로 견고한 압전 복합 분리막이 국소 전기장을 조절해 리튬 플럭스를 균일화하고 덴드라이트 성장을 억제, LiFePO4||Li셀이 2C에서 1900사이클 88.5% 용량유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Mechanochemically Disordered Li 2 Ta 2 OCl 10 Oxyhalide Unlocks Superionic Conductivity (>10 mS.cm −1 )
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state lithium‐metal batteries (ASSBs) offer a promising route to surpass the energy‐density limits of conventional lithium‐ion technology. However, their commercialization is hindered by interfacial instability, chemo‐mechanical degradation, and the limited ionic conductivity of current solid electrolytes, driving the search for new fast‐ion conductors, particularly among lithium oxyhalides. Here, we report a new lithium tantalum oxychloride, Li 2 Ta 2 OCl 10 , synthesized via a simple low‐temperature route. The material crystallizes in a triclinic structure composed of isolated [Ta 2 OCl 10 ] 2− dimers and exhibits a room‐temperature ionic conductivity of 0.002 mS.cm − 1 . Ball milling dramatically enhances Li + transport, increasing the conductivity by a factor of 5000 to 11 mS.cm −1 while reducing the activation energy from 0.46 to 0.27 eV. Combined structural, spectroscopic, and computational analyses reveal that this enhancement originates from the formation of a highly disordered, liquid‐like Li + sublattice. Li 2 Ta 2 OCl 10 further demonstrates a stability window of 1.89–3.70 V vs. Li x In and enables ASSBs with low polarization and excellent capacity retention (700 cycles at 1C with decay less than 20%). These results establish Li 2 Ta 2 OCl 10 as a promising superionic conductor and highlight the Li–M–O–Cl family as a fertile design space for next‐generation solid electrolytes.
papers.summary_ko: 저온 합성된 Li2Ta2OCl10 리튬 탄탈륨 옥시클로라이드를 볼밀링으로 무질서화하여 이온전도도를 5000배 향상(11 mS/cm)시키고 활성화에너지를 0.46에서 0.27eV로 낮춰, 700사이클 20% 미만의 용량감쇄를 갖는 전고체 리튬메탈전지용 초이온성 전도체를 구현했다.

papers.title: Making 1000 Wh/kg LiNiO2 Cathode Nearly Strain-Free by Complex-Concentrated Doping
papers.abstract_en: Abstract High-energy batteries require cathodes with greater capacity and specific energy. Ni-rich-layered oxides approach the performance limit of LiNiO2 (LNO), yet its practical use is hindered by severe chemomechanical degradation. Near 4.2 V, the H2-H3/H4 transition drives substantial c-axis contraction, volume shrinkage, O1 formation, oxygen loss, and rapid capacity decay. Here, we show that only 5% cobalt-free complex concentrated doping stabilizes LNO without sacrificing energy density. The modified LNO reduces c-axis strain from 7.4 to 2.1%, exhibits near-zero-strain behavior, and delivers 258 mAh•g–1 and 973 Wh•kg–1. In pouch cells, it retains 80% capacity after 1800 cycles and shows markedly improved thermal stability. These results demonstrate that complex-concentrated doping at low dopant loading can suppress strain and phase transformations at the full-Ni limit, providing a broadly applicable strategy for stabilizing high-energy intercalation electrodes while preserving their intrinsic capacity and specific energy during prolonged electrochemical cycling.
papers.summary_ko: 코발트-프리 복합농축 도핑(5%)으로 LiNiO2 양극의 H2-H3/H4 상전이에 따른 c축 변형을 7.4%에서 2.1%로 줄여 거의 무변형 특성을 구현, 258 mAh/g·973 Wh/kg을 유지하며 파우치셀에서 1800사이클 80% 용량유지율과 향상된 열안정성을 달성했다.

papers.title: Helical Keratin‐Derived Aqueous Binders for High‐Performance Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium–sulfur batteries (LSBs) possess ultrahigh energy density, low cost, and environmental friendliness, making them strong contenders for next‐generation energy storage technologies. However, their development is hindered by multiple interfacial challenges, including the shuttling of lithium polysulfides (LiPS), sluggish reaction kinetics, and severe volume expansion of the cathode. To address these issues, a multifunctional biomass‐derived aqueous binder was designed by crosslinking an α‐helical protein (α‐HP) with polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) and glycerol (GL). The α ‐helical structure of α‐HP in the α‐HP/PVA/GL adhesive acts as a “molecular spring”, effectively buffering volume expansion and stabilizing the electrode structure. Additionally, its abundant N‐ and O‐containing polar groups efficiently anchor LiPS, significantly suppressing the shuttling effect and accelerating redox kinetics. Consequently, lithium‐sulfur batteries employing the α‐HP/PVA/GL binder exhibit exceptional long‐term cycling stability. The α‐HP/PVA/GL cathode delivers an initial discharge specific capacity of 737.3 mAh g −1 and retains 487.9 mAh g −1 after 600 stable cycles at 2 C, with an average capacity decay rate of only 0.056% per cycle. This study provides a green, facile, and efficient strategy for developing multifunctional binders to overcome practical bottlenecks in lithium‐sulfur battery applications.
papers.summary_ko: α-나선 단백질과 PVA, 글리세롤을 가교한 바이오매스 유래 수계 바인더가 '분자 스프링'처럼 부피 팽창을 완충하고 폴리설파이드를 흡착, 리튬-황전지에서 600사이클 후에도 487.9 mAh/g(사이클당 0.056% 감쇄)의 안정적 성능을 달성했다.

papers.title: Weak-Solvating Carboxylate Ester Electrolyte Enables Hybrid Interphase via Cooperative Additives toward Wide-Temperature Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Fast Na+ transport and durable interfacial stability remain challenging for wide-temperature Na- metal batteries. To address these issues, we developed a synergistic solvation-interphase regulation strategy by integrating methyl propanoate (MP) with a combined VC/NaDFOB additive pair. MP modifies the Na+ solvation sheath and facilitates Na+ desolvation, while VC and NaDFOB cooperatively generate a mechanically robust hybrid organicinorganic interphase. This coupled regulation enables enhanced ion transport and interfacial stability over a broad temperature range. The EC/EMC/MP + VC/NaDFOB electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 2.52 mS cm–1 at –40 ̊C and an increased Na+ transference number. Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 cells retain 96.5% of their initial capacity after 1000 cycles with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.98% at room temperature. At –20 ̊C, the cells deliver 69.4 mAh g–1 for over 900 cycles, corresponding to 82% of their room-temperature capacity. This work establishes a practical solvation-interphase regulation approach for wide-temperature Na- metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 메틸프로피오네이트(MP)와 VC/NaDFOB 첨가제를 결합한 약한 용매화 카르복실산 에스터 전해액을 통해 Na+ 탈용매화를 촉진하고 유무기 혼성 계면을 형성하는 전략을 제시했다. 이 전해액은 -40°C에서 2.52 mS/cm의 이온 전도도를 보이며, Na‖Na3V2(PO4)3 셀은 상온에서 1000사이클 후 96.5%의 용량을 유지하고 -20°C에서도 900사이클 이상 안정적으로 작동했다. 광범위한 온도 범위에서 소듐 금속 전지의 계면 안정성과 이온 수송을 동시에 개선한 사례이다.

papers.title: Quantifying Sodium Metal SEI Dissolution and Relation to Corrosion Using Quartz Crystal Microbalance
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium-metal batteries present a more abundant alternative to lithium-based batteries, with high theoretical capacity and comparable reduction potential. Ether electrolytes perform well in sodium-metal batteries under continuous cycling and are presumed to have a stable solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI). However, the solubility of sodium SEI components is a cause for concern, and SEI evolution during calendar aging is not commonly studied for the ether sodium-metal system. In this work, SEI mass formation and dissolution are quantitatively measured for NaPF6 in diglyme. For varying potential hold levels, significant SEI dissolution is observed, from 55 to 76% of the originally formed SEI. Characterization shows that in addition to organic component dissolution, inorganic salts such as NaF and NaxPOyFz are unstable in SEI during open circuit rest. This instability results in continuous corrosion of sodium metal during calendar aging, highlighting an important understanding and concern of SEI stability in sodium-metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 수정 결정 미세저울(QCM)을 이용해 에터계 전해질(디글라임 중 NaPF6)에서 형성된 소듐 금속 SEI의 용해 거동을 정량적으로 측정했다. 개방 회로 휴지 중 SEI 질량의 55~76%가 용해되며, NaF 및 NaxPOyFz 등 무기 성분도 불안정하여 소듐 금속의 지속적인 부식을 유발함을 밝혔다. 이는 에터 전해질 기반 소듐 금속 전지의 저장(calendar aging) 안정성에 대한 우려를 제기한다.

papers.title: Thermodynamic Suppression of Deprotonation in Succinonitrile‐Based Electrolyte for Durable Solid‐State Sodium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries (SSMBs) offer a low‐cost, safe, and high‐energy‐density energy‐storage technology. While succinonitrile (SN) is widely adopted in solid and gel electrolytes for its high dielectric constant, exceptional oxidative stability, and robust cathode compatibility, its practical application is limited by parasitic reactions with Na metal, including deprotonation and polymerization. Herein, we demonstrated a thermodynamic suppression strategy of deprotonation that substantially inhibits parasitic reactions in SN‐based electrolytes for durable SSMBs. By utilizing an acrylonitrile (AN) based polymer as the host framework, we establish an optimized interaction with free SN that thermodynamically disfavors the parasitic decomposition, effectively stabilizing the α‐hydrogens of the methylene groups against deprotonation. The rationally designed electrolyte exhibits high ionic conductivity of 2.17 mS cm −1 and exceptional compatibility with Na metal, enabling stable cycling of Na | Na symmetric cells for 6200 h. Na | Vanadium phosphate sodium full cells retain 95.6% capacity after 5000 cycles at 1.0 C, 93.4% after 10000 cycles at 2.0 C, and pouch cells with an ultra‐high cathode loading of 20 mg cm −2 demonstrate stable performance. This work establishes thermodynamic suppression of deprotonation as a foundational design principle for high‐energy‐density and long‐lifespan SSMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 숙시노니트릴(SN) 기반 고체 전해질에서 소듐 금속과의 부반응(탈양성자화 및 중합)을 억제하기 위해 아크릴로니트릴(AN) 기반 고분자 호스트로 자유 SN과의 상호작용을 조절하는 열역학적 억제 전략을 제시했다. 이 전해질은 2.17 mS/cm의 높은 이온 전도도와 우수한 Na 금속 호환성을 보여 Na|Na 대칭 셀이 6200시간 동안 안정적으로 작동했고, Na|인산바나듐소듐 풀셀은 1.0C에서 5000사이클 후 95.6%, 2.0C에서 10000사이클 후 93.4%의 용량을 유지했다. 20 mg/cm² 고로딩 파우치 셀에서도 안정적인 성능을 보여 고에너지밀도 고체 소듐 금속 전지의 설계 원칙을 제시한다.
